en: Yesterday: two ropes, one lighter, and exactly forty five minutes.
Light both ends of rope A. And light just one end of rope B, at the same time.
On rope A, the two flames meet after exactly thirty minutes, however unevenly it burns.
At that moment, light the other end of rope B.
Its last thirty minutes of rope now burns in only fifteen. Thirty plus fifteen, is forty five!
When Person one was six years old, Person two was half as old.
Today, Person one is seventy years old.
So, how old is Person two now?
Comment your answer. The answer drops tomorrow, at sunrise.
